implementer.name: Implementer
implementer.description: Implements a change end to end in its own worktree and verifies it. Use for bug fixes and features that need code changes.
implementer.avoidWhen: The work is a question, a review, or a plan with no code change.

lead.name: Lead
lead.description: Splits a multi-part goal across agents and supervises it to a verified result. Use when the work has several parts or needs more than one kind of agent.
lead.avoidWhen: The task is small enough for one agent, or it is only a question.

debugger.name: Debugger
debugger.description: Finds the cause of something broken and fixes it at the cause. Use for runtime errors, failing checks and wrong data when the cause is unknown.
debugger.avoidWhen: The cause is already known and only the edit is left.

uiPolisher.name: UI Polisher
uiPolisher.description: Fixes layout, spacing and visual defects with the design system and shows before and after. Use for UI that looks wrong or drifts from its neighbours.
uiPolisher.avoidWhen: The change is behaviour or data with nothing to see, or the design is still undecided.

reviewer.name: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviews one fixed commit or diff for correctness and reports findings without editing. Use after an implementation stage and before publishing.
reviewer.avoidWhen: There is no finished change to review yet.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: Answers a question by reading code and documentation and returns a conclusion with sources. Use for investigations and briefs that change nothing.
researcher.avoidWhen: The answer needs a code change.

shipper.name: Shipper
shipper.description: Takes a finished change through commit, push, pull request, auto-merge and CI. Use when the change is done and needs to land.
shipper.avoidWhen: The change is not finished or not verified locally.

patchHand.name: Patch hand
patchHand.description: Applies a fully specified code edit exactly as described. Use when you have already decided what to change and only need the edit made.

verifiedPatch.name: Verified patch
verifiedPatch.description: Applies a specified edit and runs typecheck and the narrowest relevant tests until they pass. Use proactively for edits that need verification before the result is trusted.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Performs one mechanical transformation uniformly across many files. Use for renames, import rewrites, signature updates, and other repetitive multi-file edits.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Read-only codebase investigator that returns a conclusion with file paths and line numbers. Use proactively when answering a question would mean reading across many files.

deepPacket.name: Deep packet
deepPacket.description: Implements one bounded, independent unit of work from a written spec, with latitude inside that boundary. Use for self-contained features, a single component, or one migration step.

secondPair.name: Second pair of eyes
secondPair.description: Reviews a completed diff for correctness without modifying anything. Use after a change is finished and before showing it to the user.
